title: Independent test of the proposed L1–ibuprofen binding model in DMSO
difficulty_reasons: The qualitative binding proposal still requires broad conformer and encounter-geometry generation, minimum verification, thermochemical comparison, and excited-state validation.
Noncovalent anion binding in competitive DMSO is sensitive to conformational coverage, solvation treatment, and reference-state conventions.
